## type PackageIntent

PackageIntent is the compiled, immutable execution plan.

```go
type PackageIntent struct {
    // Stable identity
    ID  domain.PackageID

    // Source of manifests
    Source domain.PackageSource

    // State repository (GitOps anchor)

    // Execution behavior
    DiffEnabled bool

}
```
